name: ASTRA AGRO LESTARI TBK, PT Regi
summary: ASTRA AGRO LESTARI TBK, PT is an Indonesian agribusiness company that primarily cultivates and processes palm oil. The company is involved in the production of crude palm oil (CPO) and palm kernel oil (PKO). ASTRA AGRO LESTARI TBK, PT is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
